written.headline: OpenAI models and Codex workflows added to Google Cloud Marketplace
written.summary: OpenAI announced that its frontier models and Codex workflows will be available on Google Cloud’s Gemini Model Garden via the Cloud Marketplace. The integration lets users access these models through Google Cloud services.

written.headline: OpenAI, PerturbAI and Scripps use AI agents to find leads in brain cell data
written.summary: OpenAI, PerturbAI and Scripps Research deployed thousands of distributed AI agents to analyze data from millions of brain cells. The agents identified promising research leads in the complex biological dataset.

written.headline: Google Cloud and NVIDIA launch general availability of Vera Rubin A5X instances
written.summary: Google Cloud and NVIDIA announced the general availability of A5X instances built on NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 GPUs, with plans to expand to Europe and scale up to 960,000 Rubin GPUs. Ineffable Intelligence, founded by AlphaGo creator David Silver, is the first customer using the platform for large‑scale reinforcement learning.

written.headline: NVIDIA launches open Nemotron 3.5 and Kumo models for European industries
written.summary: NVIDIA announced new open-weight models—including Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, Nemotron 3.5 Bolt, Nemotron Retriever, Kumo Structured and Engine, Cosmos 3.5, Alpamayo 2 Edge, BioNeMo, and Ising—to let developers and enterprises in Europe customize AI with local data. Partners such as Black Forest Labs, H-Company and Mistral and customers like Dassault Systèmes, Salesforce and Accenture are already working with the models.

written.headline: Mistral AI opens preview of Mistral Large 4, a 1‑trillion‑parameter multimodal model
written.summary: Mistral AI released a public preview of Mistral Large 4, a 1‑trillion‑parameter multimodal model with 52 billion active parameters. The company plans to release the model weights by the end of October and is testing it with cybersecurity partners and state authorities.

written.headline: Mistral AI releases Voxtral 3 voice agent SDK with multilingual speech models
written.summary: Mistral AI announced the Voxtral 3 family of speech-to-text and text-to-speech models along with a voice agent SDK for real‑time, multi‑step conversations in over 50 languages. The models and SDK are available through Mistral’s EU‑hosted API or for self‑deployment, offering data sovereignty and low‑latency interactions for contact‑center agents and virtual assistants.

written.headline: Anthropic’s Claude designs 17 protein binders against scorpion neurotoxins
written.summary: Anthropic used its Claude model to generate 211 protein minibinder designs targeting four scorpion neurotoxins. Experimental testing by Adaptyv Bio and Twist Bioscience identified 17 binders that met the criteria.

written.headline: OpenAI launches Patch the Planet to coordinate response to critical open‑source bugs
written.summary: Patch the Planet links security researchers, maintainers and incident responders to address critical vulnerabilities in open‑source software.
